name: 01 Auth Onboarding Gate
description: Gate: wallet auth (human signature) -> session -> role select (human BUSINESS/INVESTOR) -> status. Captured nextStep/role decides whether workflow 02 (BUSINESS) or 03 (INVESTOR) runs next.

steps.name: request-challenge
steps.description: Connect wallet: get challenge to sign.

steps.name: verify-signature-HUMAN-INPUT
steps.description: HUMAN INPUT: sign challenge message in Leather/Xverse, paste signature over the placeholder before running.

steps.name: select-role
steps.description: CONDITION INPUT: human sets BUSINESS or INVESTOR here. Captured nextStep gates workflow 2 vs 3.

steps.name: onboarding-status-gate
steps.description: CONDITION GATE: nextStep contains BUSINESS -> run workflow 02; INVESTOR -> run workflow 03.
